title: Mathematics — independent vocabulary landscape and compositional structures
scope: Independent navigable mathematical vocabulary. A term need not be connected to a question, source page, proof or implementation; presence does not establish equivalence, an applicable theorem or an achieved competence.
id_policy: Opaque permanent domain-local IDs; never regenerate or renumber; redirects only when merging genuine conceptual synonyms.
related_ids_semantics: Related concepts are distinct unless explicitly represented as aliases; relationships do not imply identical hypotheses or theorem prerequisites.
